src='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = grid[0][0]
    original = [row[:] for row in grid]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Every adjacent equal-color diagonal pair marks a diagonal ray. Extend
    # outward from both ends, stopping at any existing non-background cell.
    for r in range(h - 1):
        for c in range(w):
            for dc in (-1, 1):
                c2 = c + dc
                if 0 <= c2 < w and original[r][c] != bg and original[r][c] == original[r + 1][c2]:
                    color = original[r][c]
                    for rr, cc, dr, dcol in ((r, c, -1, -dc), (r + 1, c2, 1, dc)):
                        rr += dr
                        cc += dcol
                        while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and original[rr][cc] == bg:
                            out[rr][cc] = color
                            rr += dr
                            cc += dcol
    return out
'''
